name: rust-anything
description: rust-anything: find the hot loop in your TypeScript, Python, C, Go, Ruby or Java code, move it to Rust, and prove nothing else changed.

plugins.name: rust-anything
plugins.description: Rewrite your app in Rust, one piece at a time, checked against the original's recorded behavior at every step. Needs the rust-anything CLI on PATH (cargo install rust-anything).
